title: Nilotic peoples facts for kids
text: Nilotic cultures are rich with traditions. Many groups have strong spiritual beliefs. They often believe in a supreme being or creator. Ancestors also play an important role in their spiritual lives. Traditional ceremonies and rituals are common.
